conflicts.description: Chenault's 2021 audit committee seat. The 2022 proxy says he 'also served on our audit committee from January 1, 2021 to December 14, 2021'. But the 2021 proxy (filed 2021-04-30) contradicts this. It names only Jordan, Lin and Mather as audit members and lists Chenault only on the compensation and nominating committees. Its audit committee report is signed by Mather, Jordan and Lin alone. Committee rows follow each filing as written, so no audit row is recorded for Chenault.

open_questions: Founders' board start dates (Chesky, Gebbia, Blecharczyk) are not in any SEC filing. Bios say only that they co-founded the company in 2008 (incorporated 2008-06-27). The 2012 Form D lists all three as directors, so they were on the board no later than 2012-10-23. Start dates are left null.
Chesky's start dates as Chair and as CEO are not disclosed. He holds both roles at the IPO and in every proxy through 2026.
When Chenault was appointed lead director is not disclosed. He already held the role in the S-1 filed 2020-11-16.

Gebbia's exact employment end date is not disclosed. The 2022 proxy (2022-04-22) still lists him as an executive officer. His advisor agreement, effective 2022-08-23, makes him an independent contractor. So the executive role ended in 2022 (recorded at year precision).

Undated committee-chair changes: Lin replaced Mather as audit chair, and Ahrendts replaced Lin as compensation chair, between the 2021 proxy (2021-04-30) and the 2022 proxy (2022-04-22). Ahuja replaced Lin as audit chair between the 2025 proxy (2025-04-25) and the 2026 proxy (2026-04-24). No filing dates these changes.

Board size around appointments is not stated. Ahuja joined 2021-12-14 and Mather left 2021-12-15. Authorized size went 9 -> 8 at the 2023-06-01 meeting, but the Manyika 8-K (2023-09-07) does not say it was raised back to 9. The 2024 proxy says nine directors.
Mather's resignation was disclosed only in the Q3 2021 10-Q (Item 5 Other Information) and the 2022 proxy. No 8-K Item 5.02 was found for it.
Pre-IPO departed directors are not tracked. For example, Greg McAdoo appears as a director on the 2012 Form D, but no filing reviewed gives his dates.
Independence roles span each director's tenure, but the filings only give point-in-time determinations (the IPO prospectus and each proxy).

Other-board lists come from Airbnb's own bios (2026 proxy for current directors; the 2021 proxy for Mather; the 2022 proxy for Johnson). They are not checked against other issuers' filings, and Mather's and Johnson's 'current' boards are only as of those proxies.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A (2026-04-24), the 2026-06-05 annual-meeting 8-K and every 8-K through 2026-09-30. No Item 5.02 8-K was filed after 2025-11-21, and that one was officer-only. Also checked: the 10-Q Item 5 sections through 2026-08-06, every Form 3 (none after 2024-03-07, and that one was the CFO), and Forms 4 filed May-Sept 2026 by all nine directors.

Reviewed the IPO 424B4 and S-1, every DEF 14A (2021-2026), every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07, the Other Information item (Item 5/9B) of every 10-Q and 10-K since the IPO, and every Form 3. Joins dated from 8-Ks and Forms 3; departures from the 10-Q, 8-Ks and annual-meeting 8-Ks.
Pre-IPO seats reconstructed only from IPO prospectus and proxy biographies (plus the 2012 Form D roster). Pre-IPO departures are not covered.
